transcript: For three years I have been practicing the piano every morning My daily effort has slowly been paying off I have been working on a single piece of music for a long time Every day I have continued to practice Sometimes I have struggled But I have never stopped I used to be unable to play fast In the past my fingers would tangle And the notes would break Lately, however, my fingers have been moving In a steady way I have become devoted to shaping every sound My playing has gradually been improving And my ability has been developing for several months now I have noticed slow but steady growth in myself Today, I accomplished something important At a small recital I played all the way to the last note Without stopping That small achievement was the quiet result Of all the time I had spent practicing

segments.text: For three years I have been practicing the piano every morning
My daily effort has slowly been paying off
I have been working on a single piece of music for a long time
Every day I have continued to practice
Sometimes I have struggled
But I have never stopped
I used to be unable to play fast
In the past my fingers would tangle
And the notes would break
Lately, however, my fingers have been moving
In a steady way
I have become devoted to shaping every sound
My playing has gradually been improving
And my ability has been developing for several months now
I have noticed slow but steady growth in myself
Today, I accomplished something important
At a small recital
I played all the way to the last note
Without stopping
That small achievement was the quiet result
Of all the time I had spent practicing
